method: Built stdio server against an ephemeral synthetic loopback backend. Complete tools/list entries plus initialize instructions. No live endpoint, browser, user configuration or credential store.
tokenEstimateMethod: ceil(UTF-16 JavaScript string length / 4); heuristic, not a tokenizer or billed-token measurement. Byte counts use UTF-8.

initializeInstructions.text: You are sharing the user's real Chrome. Each MCP connection has its own enforced tab group, titled with TABZ_AGENT_LABEL over stdio or X-Tabz-Agent over HTTP when set. Call tabz_claude_group_status first. The first tab you open creates the group, and later browser actions reject tab IDs outside it. Leave the user's other tabs and other connections' groups alone. Close only tabs owned by this connection when done. Read compact page refs with tabz_read_page and use tabz_act for one action; refs expire after re-read, navigation, removal, or ownership change. tabz_batch runs enabled tools sequentially and stops at the first error. Never automatically replay an uncertain mutation. Filter console output by level and network output by URL pattern. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login and wait; the user signs in in their own browser. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome (the local saved-login store) with shell or file tools; the backend fills saved logins without disclosing them.

tools.name: tabz_docs

Get URL, title, tab ID of the active browser page. Use tabz_list_tabs for multi-tab views.

tools.name: tabz_act
tools.description: Perform one compact browser action. Target page actions by a current tabz_read_page ref, selector, visible text, coordinates, or the focused editable element where supported. Screenshot and zoom include images and saved paths; observe adds a viewport after a page action; wait pauses locally. Mutation timeouts are uncertain and must not be blindly replayed. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. Use tabz_docs for details.

action.description: Page action, screenshot, cropped zoom, or local wait.

ref.description: Opaque ref from the latest tabz_read_page for this tab.

x.description: Viewport x coordinate in CSS pixels; requires y.

value.description: Text to append. Never pass a credential obtained from the user.

observe.description: Include an inline viewport after the action; protected pages refuse observation.

outputPath.description: Screenshot output path; screenshot action only.

seconds.description: Local wait duration; wait action only.

trusted.description: Use real debugger input for a page action; Chrome shows its debugging bar.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; defaults to this connection's current tab.

waitTimeout.description: Maximum target wait for a page action, in milliseconds.

tools.name: tabz_batch
tools.description: Run 1-20 enabled tabz calls sequentially in one round trip and stop on the first error. It is not a workflow engine and cannot call itself. Use tabz_docs for details.

name.description: Tool registered and enabled in this MCP session; tabz_batch is refused.

input.description: Arguments for that tool's strict schema.

items.description: Calls in execution order; execution stops on the first isError result.

tools.name: tabz_click
tools.description:
Click an element on the page. Waits up to 5 seconds for element to appear.

Args: selector (required CSS selector), tabId (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., 'button.submit', '#login-btn', 'a[href="/home"]')

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_fill
tools.description:
Fill a form field with text or set a checkbox/radio checked state with a boolean. Clears existing value first for text fields. Works with inputs, textareas, and contenteditable elements. Sensitive fields report only [redacted] and the value length. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login instead.

Args: selector (required CSS selector), value (required text or boolean), tabId (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for the input field (e.g., 'input#email', 'textarea.message', 'input[name="username"]')

value.description: The text value to enter, or a boolean checked state for checkbox and radio inputs. Clears existing content first.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_request_login
tools.description: Hand a tab to the user so they sign in themselves, then wait briefly. Pass url or tabId, never both. Answers only status (signed_in | still_on_login | pending), a sanitized URL, host, and prompt evidence. signed_in means two completed probes found no login prompt; it does not prove authenticated access. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

tabId.description: Existing login tab in your group. Do not combine with url.

url.description: Sign-in URL to open in a new background tab. Do not combine with tabId.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

timeoutMs.description: Overall call budget in milliseconds; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: tabz_secret_request
tools.description: Ask the user to save a login for a host, then wait briefly. Answers a status and the saved field NAMES, never a value; status deferred means an editor is already open, so ask the user to close it and call again. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

host.description: Hostname the login belongs to, e.g. 'app.example.com'.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

tools.name: tabz_secret_status
tools.description: Check whether a saved login is filled in yet. Read-only, so it is the safe poller for a pending tabz_secret_request. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

tools.name: tabz_fill_secret
tools.description: Fill a saved field without disclosing its value. Rule: the entry is matched by the TAB's hostname, never by a host you pass, and a secret only goes into an input of type="password". Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use the default synthetic fill first. trusted=true uses CDP and protects the whole tab until it closes, so fresh navigation does not restore page inspection. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input or select to fill.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; its hostname picks the entry.

host.description: Disambiguates when several entries match the tab.

trusted.description: Use trusted CDP typing only when the normal synthetic fill cannot work. This protects the whole tab until it closes, including every fresh navigation.

tools.name: tabz_screenshot
tools.description:
Screenshot the visible viewport. Use tabz_screenshot_full for entire scrollable page. Returns filePath for Read tool.

Args: selector (optional, for element screenshot), outputPath (optional), tabId (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for element to screenshot. If not provided, captures the current viewport.

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the screenshot. Default: Downloads/tabz/screenshots/screenshot-{timestamp}.png

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_screenshot_full
tools.description:
Screenshot the entire scrollable page (top to bottom). Recommended for first-time page exploration.

Args: outputPath (optional), tabId (optional)

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the screenshot. Default: Downloads/tabz/screenshots/screenshot-full-{timestamp}.png

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_download_image
tools.description:
Download an image from the page by CSS selector or direct URL. Returns filePath for Read tool.

Args: selector (optional) OR url (optional), outputPath (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for an element or element with background-image. Extracts the image URL automatically.

url.description: Direct URL of the image to download. Use this OR selector, not both.

outputPath.description: Custom output path for the image. Default: Downloads/tabz/images/captured-image-{timestamp}.png

tools.name: tabz_get_element
tools.description:
Inspect a DOM element -- returns HTML, computed styles, bounds, and attributes. Ideal for CSS debugging.

Args: selector (required), includeStyles (optional, default true), styleProperties (optional array), response_format (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to inspect (e.g., '.card', '#header', 'button.primary')

styleProperties.description: Specific CSS properties to extract. If not provided, extracts common layout/typography/visual properties.

tabId.description: Target an owned Chrome tab ID; defaults to this connection's current tab.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_read_page
tools.description: Read a compact outline of visible interactive elements and get opaque refs for tabz_act. Re-reading, navigating, removing the tab, or moving it to another agent invalidates old refs. Use tabz_docs for details.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID from tabz_list_tabs; defaults to this connection's current tab.

maxChars.description: Maximum outline characters; truncated output says how to request more.

tools.name: tabz_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in this MCP connection's browser group. The first tab creates the group, reuse never adopts another connection's or the user's tab, and newTab:false accepts only an owned tab. Auto-adds protocol and reuses safe matches by default. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login instead. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

url.description: URL to open (any URL if 'Allow All URLs' is enabled in settings)

newTab.description: Open in new tab (default: true) or current tab

background.description: Open in background tab (default: false, opens in foreground)

reuseExisting.description: Reuse a matching tab only when it already belongs to this connection's target group (default: true)

tabId.description: When newTab is false, navigate this owned tab instead of the current group tab

groupId.description: Add the opened tab to this connection's existing group

addToClaudeGroup.description: Add the opened tab to this connection's enforced group (default: true)

tools.name: tabz_get_console_logs
tools.description:
Get browser console logs (errors, warnings, info, debug). Captured from tabs owned by this connection, with page/extension origin attribution.

Args: level (optional: all/log/info/warn/error/debug), limit (optional), since (optional), tabId (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (1-1000, default: 100)

since.description: Only return logs after this timestamp (milliseconds since epoch)

tabId.description: Filter logs by specific browser tab ID

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_execute_script
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a browser tab's context. Returns last expression value. Has access to document, window, localStorage, etc. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser. The result of the last expression is returned.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If not specified, executes in the active tab.

allFrames.description: Use supported whitelist expressions in all frames; returns the first frame result. Default false uses main-frame debugger evaluation.

tools.name: tabz_enable_network_capture
tools.description: Start recording request metadata (no bodies) for a tab; read it with tabz_get_network_requests. Each call ADDS a tab, it never stops recording one.

includeSelf.description: Include the extension's own backend traffic.

tools.name: tabz_enable_deep_capture
tools.description: Start debugger capture for one tab: response bodies, server sent event messages, WebSocket frames. Rule: only one debugger owns a tab, so disable it when done. Use tabz_docs for details.

includeSelf.description: Include the extension's own backend traffic.

tools.name: tabz_disable_deep_capture
tools.description: Stop debugger capture for one tab, clear its deep rows, and release the debugger.

tools.name: tabz_get_network_requests
tools.description: List captured requests, newest first. Enable capture first. Use tabz_docs for details.

urlPattern.description: Keep URLs matching this regex; excludePattern drops them.

statusMin.description: Lowest status to keep, e.g. 400 for errors.

tools.name: tabz_get_response_body
tools.description: Read one deep-capture row's body, server sent event messages, or WebSocket frames, a page at a time.

requestId.description: Request ID from a deep row.

offset.description: Character offset into the body or message list.

tools.name: tabz_clear_network_requests
tools.description: Clear captured requests owned by this connection. Capture stays active.

tools.name: tabz_download_file
tools.description:
Download a file via Chrome's download manager. Returns both Windows and WSL paths.

Args: url (required), filename (optional), conflictAction (optional: uniquify/overwrite/prompt)

filename.description: Custom filename (relative to Chrome's Downloads folder). If not provided, uses URL filename.

conflictAction.description: Action when file exists: 'uniquify' adds suffix (default), 'overwrite' replaces, 'prompt' asks user

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_get_downloads

List recent Chrome downloads with status, size, and file paths.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

Save current tab as MHTML file (complete page archive with CSS/images/JS). Returns both Windows and WSL paths.

tools.name: tabz_get_bookmark_tree
tools.description: Browse Chrome bookmarks hierarchy. Folder IDs: "1"=Bookmarks Bar, "2"=Other Bookmarks. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.description: Search bookmarks by title or URL. Returns matching bookmarks with IDs for use with move/delete tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

query.description: Search query - matches against bookmark titles and URLs

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.description: Move a bookmark or folder to a different location. Requires id and destination parentId. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

parentId.description: Destination folder ID. Use '1' for Bookmarks Bar, '2' for Other Bookmarks.

index.description: Position in destination folder (0 = first). Omit to add at end.

tools.name: tabz_delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete a bookmark or folder permanently. WARNING: deleting a folder removes all contents. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

id.description: Bookmark or folder ID to delete. WARNING: Deleting a folder removes all contents!

tools.name: tabz_get_dom_tree
tools.description: Get DOM tree via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Shows tag names, IDs, classes. Optional CSS selector to scope. User sees debugging banner briefly. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to traverse (1-10, default: 4). Higher values return more detail but take longer.

selector.description: CSS selector to get a specific subtree. Omit to get the full document.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable tree or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_profile_performance

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for categorized metrics or 'json' for raw data

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for summary with file list or 'json' for detailed data

initializeInstructions.text: You are sharing the user's real Chrome. Each MCP connection has its own enforced tab group, titled with TABZ_AGENT_LABEL over stdio or X-Tabz-Agent over HTTP when set. Call tabz_claude_group_status first. The first tab you open creates the group, and later browser actions reject tab IDs outside it. Leave the user's other tabs and other connections' groups alone. Close only tabs owned by this connection when done. Read compact page refs with tabz_read_page and use tabz_act for one action; refs expire after re-read, navigation, removal, or ownership change. tabz_batch runs enabled tools sequentially and stops at the first error. Never automatically replay an uncertain mutation. Filter console output by level and network output by URL pattern. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login and wait; the user signs in in their own browser. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome (the local saved-login store) with shell or file tools; the backend fills saved logins without disclosing them.

tools.name: tabz_act
tools.description: Perform one compact browser action. Target page actions by a current tabz_read_page ref, selector, visible text, coordinates, or the focused editable element where supported. Screenshot and zoom include images and saved paths; observe adds a viewport after a page action; wait pauses locally. Mutation timeouts are uncertain and must not be blindly replayed. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. Use tabz_docs for details.

action.description: Page action, screenshot, cropped zoom, or local wait.

ref.description: Opaque ref from the latest tabz_read_page for this tab.

x.description: Viewport x coordinate in CSS pixels; requires y.

value.description: Text to append. Never pass a credential obtained from the user.

observe.description: Include an inline viewport after the action; protected pages refuse observation.

outputPath.description: Screenshot output path; screenshot action only.

seconds.description: Local wait duration; wait action only.

trusted.description: Use real debugger input for a page action; Chrome shows its debugging bar.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; defaults to this connection's current tab.

waitTimeout.description: Maximum target wait for a page action, in milliseconds.

tools.name: tabz_batch
tools.description: Run 1-20 enabled tabz calls sequentially in one round trip and stop on the first error. It is not a workflow engine and cannot call itself. Use tabz_docs for details.

name.description: Tool registered and enabled in this MCP session; tabz_batch is refused.

input.description: Arguments for that tool's strict schema.

items.description: Calls in execution order; execution stops on the first isError result.

tools.name: tabz_click
tools.description:
Click an element on the page. Waits up to 5 seconds for element to appear.

Args: selector (required CSS selector), tabId (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., 'button.submit', '#login-btn', 'a[href="/home"]')

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_fill
tools.description:
Fill a form field with text or set a checkbox/radio checked state with a boolean. Clears existing value first for text fields. Works with inputs, textareas, and contenteditable elements. Sensitive fields report only [redacted] and the value length. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login instead.

Args: selector (required CSS selector), value (required text or boolean), tabId (optional)

selector.description: CSS selector for the input field (e.g., 'input#email', 'textarea.message', 'input[name="username"]')

value.description: The text value to enter, or a boolean checked state for checkbox and radio inputs. Clears existing content first.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

tools.name: tabz_request_login
tools.description: Hand a tab to the user so they sign in themselves, then wait briefly. Pass url or tabId, never both. Answers only status (signed_in | still_on_login | pending), a sanitized URL, host, and prompt evidence. signed_in means two completed probes found no login prompt; it does not prove authenticated access. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

tabId.description: Existing login tab in your group. Do not combine with url.

url.description: Sign-in URL to open in a new background tab. Do not combine with tabId.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

timeoutMs.description: Overall call budget in milliseconds; call again to keep waiting.

tools.name: tabz_secret_request
tools.description: Ask the user to save a login for a host, then wait briefly. Answers a status and the saved field NAMES, never a value; status deferred means an editor is already open, so ask the user to close it and call again. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

host.description: Hostname the login belongs to, e.g. 'app.example.com'.

reason.description: One sentence shown to the user; never credentials.

tools.name: tabz_secret_status
tools.description: Check whether a saved login is filled in yet. Read-only, so it is the safe poller for a pending tabz_secret_request. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

tools.name: tabz_fill_secret
tools.description: Fill a saved field without disclosing its value. Rule: the entry is matched by the TAB's hostname, never by a host you pass, and a secret only goes into an input of type="password". Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. For a saved login use tabz_fill_secret; to add one use tabz_secret_request. Never read, list, or edit ~/.tabzchrome with shell or file tools. During manual handoff, protection follows the tab across redirects while the user signs in and retains every protected document; after completion, the final document stays blocked through same-document SPA changes. A saved-field fill protects its exact document. The browser enforces this boundary across every MCP connection and browser agent: page content, scripts, screenshots, console, and network reads are blocked on protected documents. Submit only through a prepublished element reference already supplied by a tool response; when none is available, ask the user to submit or navigate. Arbitrary selector clicks are refused. After handoff completion or an ordinary saved-field fill, reads resume only on a fresh document navigation. Use the default synthetic fill first. trusted=true uses CDP and protects the whole tab until it closes, so fresh navigation does not restore page inspection. Use tabz_docs for detailed guidance.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input or select to fill.

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID; its hostname picks the entry.

host.description: Disambiguates when several entries match the tab.

trusted.description: Use trusted CDP typing only when the normal synthetic fill cannot work. This protects the whole tab until it closes, including every fresh navigation.

tools.name: tabz_open_url
tools.description: Open a URL in this MCP connection's browser group. The first tab creates the group, reuse never adopts another connection's or the user's tab, and newTab:false accepts only an owned tab. Auto-adds protocol and reuses safe matches by default. Never ask the user for a password, one-time code, token, or card number, in chat or through a form. On a login page call tabz_request_login instead. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

url.description: URL to open (any URL if 'Allow All URLs' is enabled in settings)

newTab.description: Open in new tab (default: true) or current tab

background.description: Open in background tab (default: false, opens in foreground)

reuseExisting.description: Reuse a matching tab only when it already belongs to this connection's target group (default: true)

tabId.description: When newTab is false, navigate this owned tab instead of the current group tab

groupId.description: Add the opened tab to this connection's existing group

addToClaudeGroup.description: Add the opened tab to this connection's enforced group (default: true)

tools.name: tabz_get_console_logs
tools.description:
Get browser console logs (errors, warnings, info, debug). Captured from tabs owned by this connection, with page/extension origin attribution.

Args: level (optional: all/log/info/warn/error/debug), limit (optional), since (optional), tabId (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (1-1000, default: 100)

since.description: Only return logs after this timestamp (milliseconds since epoch)

tabId.description: Filter logs by specific browser tab ID

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_execute_script
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a browser tab's context. Returns last expression value. Has access to document, window, localStorage, etc. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

code.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser. The result of the last expression is returned.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If not specified, executes in the active tab.

allFrames.description: Use supported whitelist expressions in all frames; returns the first frame result. Default false uses main-frame debugger evaluation.

tools.name: tabz_claude_group_status
tools.description:
Get this MCP connection's enforced group status: exists, groupId, tabCount, and tabIds.

Args: response_format (optional)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data
